column1: Complete system installation accepted by Aker Kvaerner Chemetics Field Supervisor. (See signed Contractor Field Check List)
Check cadwelds and connections to equipment for soundness.
Check access to test points and temporarily remove ground loop from ground rod.
Test ground rods as per Aker Kvaerner Chemetics grounding standards.
Reconnect ground loop to ground rods.
Test complete ground system as per Aker Kvaerner Chemetics grounding standards and as per attached Test Sheet No. ______.
After completion of construction and after grounding system has been accepted by Aker Kvaerner Chemetics, check that painting with asphaltic compound protects all ground connections.
